search: Two complete coordinate sweeps from the discovery-selected best fixed action. Four common template draws score search candidates. Sixteen separate common draws score final comparisons.
objective: Maximize SLO-qualified output tokens/s. Use lower TTFTp95 to break exact goodput ties.
safety: Predicted ITLp99 and TPOTp95 must not exceed1.05 times the Native prediction. Absolute TTFT5000/everyITL34/TPOT33 thresholds are unchanged.
scope: Fixed actions are selected on discovery prompts before held-out search. The oracle sees the complete held-out arrival trace and controlled output length. Every candidate resimulates P,D,credit acquisition and credit return. Finite coordinate search is not a global optimum or a certified upper bound. C0 whole-request serialization is not a C3 safe-window model. Predicted decode gates are not measured server-start confidence intervals.
